items.title: 70399_Theodore _Red_ Saunders oral history interview
items.q: "And T'zol, Juan Tizol." ... "Red, that date that we talked about last week, with Woody Herman, Juan Tizol, Ben Webster and Johnny Hodges and you... I think it had to be about '44, around '43 or '44."

ctx.x: "Perdido" was one of them. "The Music Stopped," Ben Webster was on the thing, right. Johnny Hodges, yeah, right, right. And T'zol, Juan Tizol.*
Yeah, (inaudible) "Down in Basie's Basement", is that --
